description.value:
You configure a heap of scrap within range into a fully functioning vehicle. The junk becomes a level 0 land vehicle, such as a hoverboard, in an unoccupied adjacent space. The vehicle is clearly temporary, can't be sold or traded, and falls apart into worthless junk when the spell ends. The spell ends early if the vehicle becomes broken.

Heightened (3rd) You create a 1st-level or lower land or water vehicle, such as a boatercycle or forklift.

Heightened (4th) You create a 4th-level or lower land or water vehicle, such as an urban cruiser or torpedo minisub.

Heightened (5th) You create a 5th-level or lower air, land, or water vehicle, such as a skyboat or turboglider.

Heightened (6th) You create a 7th-level or lower vehicle of any kind, such as a drop pod.

Heightened (7th) You create a 9th-level or lower vehicle.

Heightened (8th) You create an 11th-level or lower vehicle.

Heightened (9th) You create a 13th-level or lower vehicle.

Heightened (10th) You create a 15th-level or lower vehicle.
